symptom: Nullable sort properties are unsupported in keyset scrolling
checkpoint: Verify every keyset sort property is non-null and ordering is stable before changing the predicate.

symptom: PostgreSQL integer-array syntax is quoted unexpectedly
checkpoint: Inspect provider/driver SQL rendering; the Spring Data team classified this outside its project.

symptom: Delete appears ineffective for an entity with an embedded key
checkpoint: Verify embedded-id equality, generated DELETE SQL, flush, transaction completion, and row identity.

symptom: Function predicate is misclassified as a constructor expression
checkpoint: Compare value and derived count queries with the affected and fixed Spring Data JPA versions.

symptom: Native pageable query is rewritten incorrectly
checkpoint: Capture native value query, explicit/derived count query, sort, parameters, and generated SQL.

symptom: Derived page count query omits a condition
checkpoint: Run the value and count queries separately against the same bindings and snapshot.

symptom: Procedure invocation generates one argument too many
checkpoint: Compare Java declaration, JPA metadata, database signature including return value, and generated call.

symptom: Transaction synchronization appears to propagate incorrectly across managers
checkpoint: Record selected manager and bound resources at each proxy boundary; do not assume cross-manager atomicity.

symptom: LazyInitializationException occurs in a GraalVM native image
checkpoint: Compare JVM/native execution, proxy hints, persistence-context lifetime, and exact association access.

symptom: Nested transaction savepoint behavior regresses with Oracle
checkpoint: Verify framework/driver versions, manager nested-transaction setting, savepoint SQL, and fixed release.

symptom: JdbcTemplate connection is rolled back by Hikari before JpaTransactionManager commit
checkpoint: Confirm JdbcTemplate and JPA share the same transaction-aware datasource and connection binding.

symptom: Repeated NoTransactionInContextException contributes to memory pressure
checkpoint: Inspect context loss and exception allocation on the affected version; validate against the fixed version.

symptom: Transaction cleanup is missing after a reactive publisher is canceled
checkpoint: Trace cancel/finally signals, resource binding, rollback, and connection release without assuming confirmation.

symptom: BEFORE_COMMIT listener with REQUIRES_NEW may retain checked-out JDBC connections
checkpoint: Measure simultaneous outer/inner connections, listener phase, suspension, completion, and release.

symptom: Cacheable interception throws NullPointerException after the method throws RuntimeException
checkpoint: Preserve the original business exception and compare interceptor behavior on the fixed release.

symptom: QueryTimeoutException during cache get has disputed fallback behavior
checkpoint: Verify CacheErrorHandler configuration and distinguish provider lookup failure from target invocation.

symptom: Parameter-based cache keys on repository methods cannot be resolved in some builds
checkpoint: Inspect runtime parameter names, compiler flags, proxy method, and computed SpEL key.

symptom: A custom key generator returns null and cache invocation fails
checkpoint: Treat null as an invalid key-generator result and inspect the real method arguments.

symptom: Reactive caching path does not use the error handler for a synchronous cache
checkpoint: Record cache API sync/async capability, return type, and exact error path for the framework version.

symptom: Cache operation spends significant time computing hashCode
checkpoint: Profile key generation and object hashCode before attributing overhead to the cache abstraction.

symptom: allEntries eviction may remove keys inserted concurrently after invocation
checkpoint: Reconstruct invocation, insert, commit, and clear ordering; do not present the open report as confirmed.

symptom: Flyway prevents GraalVM native-image startup
checkpoint: Check Boot, Flyway, native-image metadata, replacement issue, and first startup exception.

symptom: Liquibase fails after a Spring Boot patch upgrade
checkpoint: Compare managed Liquibase/database versions and underlying exception; ownership was classified external.

symptom: Configured Hikari pool name is not observed as expected
checkpoint: Inspect effective configuration binding and actual datasource/pool instance before changing properties.

symptom: Hikari data-source-class-name configuration still requires a driver class and rejects both
checkpoint: Compare URL, driver-class-name, data-source-class-name, Hikari constraints, and fixed Boot release.
